$schemaComment: CENTRAL PRICING CONFIG — all commercial £ values for the public quote engine. UI components must not hard-code fares. See `pricingModel` for the formula.

pricingModel.summary: Universal road-distance journey fare (shared/universal-distance-pricing.ts) → vehicle (Estate = Saloon + £6) → optional 5% return discount → airport fixed costs → Express/access add-on in UI. Zone tables and Belfast mile floor are retired for live quotes.
pricingModel.addressToAddress: Same universal distance curve as airport transfers. Requires valid OSRM road metrics; otherwise no fare.
pricingModel.airport: Journey fare from road miles only (piecewise Saloon: 4→£30, 15→£50, 32→£80, 98→£230; nearest £1). Estate = Saloon + £6. Zone surcharges and belfastAirportDistanceFloor do not override. No weekend/Bank Holiday journey surcharge (premium rates are 0).
pricingModel.dublinAirport: Priced on the same universal distance curve for the road miles to/from DUB, then airportFixedCostsGbp (drop-off +£4 M1; pickup +£5 parking +£4 M1). Long-distance ~98 miles targets ~£230 Saloon journey before fixed costs.
pricingModel.vehicles: Saloon 1–4 pax AND 0–2 large cases; Estate 1–4 pax AND 3–4 cases (+£6 vs Saloon); Minibus 5–7 (builds from Estate × multiplier).
pricingModel.returnDiscount: returnJourneyDiscountRate (exactly 5%) applied once to (2 × oneWay journey fare). Airport fixed costs and Express are added after and are never discounted.
pricingModel.airportFixedCosts: Per-leg: BFS/BHD £0 on address↔airport; DUB drop £4 M1 / pick £5 parking +£4 M1; LDY drop £1 / pick £2.50. Express Drop-Off is a separate optional add-on (BFS £5 / BHD £4).
pricingModel.rounding: Universal journey: Saloon rounded to nearest £1; Estate = that Saloon + £6 (not re-rounded). Website, email, booking and payment use the same journey amount.

operational.description: Optional cost breakdown fields (empty return, time, tolls, airport charges). When weekday/weekend £ rates are filled, A2A quotes use this model; otherwise the OTS reference model is used.

airportAccessFeesGbp.note: DEPRECATED. Live address↔airport BFS/BHD fees are £0; A2A BFS↔BHD retains destination-end historical surcharge via shared/airport-fixed-costs getAirportToAirportFixedCostGbp.

airportFixedCostsGbp.note: BFS/BHD drop-off and pickup fees £0 on address↔airport. DUB pickup/parking £5 + M1 toll £4; drop-off fee £0 + M1 toll £4. LDY pickup £2.50, drop-off £1. DUB/LDY never removable; BFS/BHD keep free-area choice. A2A BFS↔BHD waives collection surcharge only (keep destination £5/£4) — see shared/airport-fixed-costs.ts.

airportEstatePremiumTiers.note: RETIRED for live quotes. Estate is always rounded Saloon + £6 via universalDistancePricing. Historical tiers retained for calibration scripts only.

airportOtsCalibration.note: Calibration-only target vs live OTS estate for BFS/BHD/LDY zone surcharges. Does not feed the live customer quote formula. Midpoint ~£4 undercut.

belfastAirportDistanceFloor.note: RETIRED for live quotes. Universal distance pricing replaces the £65/£60 + £2/mile-over-20 floor. Kept for historical reference only.

otsReferenceModel.note: Distance/time reference for public A2A quotes. Commercial position vs OTS is applied via addressToAddressDistanceBands (short undercut, long empty-return uplift) — not a flat undercut on every journey. undercutMin/Max here are A2A-oriented fallbacks only; airport-zone calibration uses airportOtsCalibration (£3–£5).

addressToAddressDistanceBands.note: Adjustment applied to the OTS-style reference fare by loaded distance. Negative = short-trip undercut; positive = long-haul empty-return protection. Benchmarks (Belfast centre): Newry ~£81/£93, Derry ~£127/£146, Enniskillen ~£145/£165.

dublinCityBeyondAirport.note: Belfast-area to Dublin city (NOT Dublin Airport) = DUB airport fare for the NI origin + continuation beyond the airport. Never treat Dublin city as DUB.

expressDropOffFeesGbp.note: Optional customer Express Drop-Off/Pick-Up add-on on BFS/BHD airport journeys (once per booking). Not the waived automatic access fee. Keep in sync with shared/express-drop-off.ts.

expressFreePickupConfigured.note: Free pick-up / collection alternative only when true. Free drop-off is always offered for BFS/BHD. Keep in sync with EXPRESS_FREE_PICKUP_CONFIGURED in shared/express-drop-off.ts.

universalDistancePricing.note: Live airport and address↔address journey fares use road miles only. Piecewise Saloon knots: 4→£30, 15→£50, 32→£80, 98→£230. Round Saloon to nearest £1; Estate = Saloon + £6. Zone surcharges and Belfast floor do not override. Express/access added after journey fare.
